integrity: The proof is algebraic for all finite a,b at least two. Finite exact modular checks support but do not establish the infinite-family statement. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Exactly four unordered particles and the vanishing below four are covered; not a claim about integral homology of the symmetry quotient, higher particle counts or the full cohomology ring. General graph-configuration chain models and nonequivariant torus generation were known. Equivalent unindexed equivariant results remain possible.
title: The characteristic-two symmetric top cycle for four particles on a double-star tree
